story.title: Our Story
story.description: CamTek has been at the forefront of security solutions in Kuwait for over a decade. We started with a simple mission: to provide reliable, high-quality surveillance systems that protect what matters most to our clients. Today, we serve hundreds of homes, businesses, and industrial facilities across Kuwait.
